name: Scribe
ability: You start knowing 3 players: exactly 2 of them share an alignment.
flavor: They etched truth into stone so the living would not forget — even when truth whispered lies.
firstNightReminder: Point to 3 players, 2 of whom share an alignment.

name: Priest
ability: On your 1st day, publicly choose 5 players. That night, learn 2 of their roles and 1 false one.
flavor: Their voice was calm, their vision clouded — but they held the names of the chosen in their heart.
otherNightReminder: If the Priest publicly chose 5 players on day 1, show 2 of their character tokens and 1 not-in-play character token, shuffled.

name: Ankh
ability: Each night*, choose a dead player: they regain their ability until dusk.
flavor: With sacred breath, they call the spirit back. But only until the sun sets.
otherNightReminder: The Ankh chooses a dead player: mark them RESTORED.

name: Scarab
ability: Each night, choose a player: if any other ability chose them tonight, you learn it.
flavor: It watches quietly beneath the sand, stirring only when danger shifts the wind.
firstNightReminder: The Scarab chooses a player. Nod if any other ability chose them tonight.
otherNightReminder: The Scarab chooses a player. Nod if any other ability chose them tonight.

name: Glyph
ability: Each night, choose a player: you learn a word from their character's flavor text.
flavor: Though silent, the mark speaks. One word is all it takes to disturb the balance.
firstNightReminder: The Glyph chooses a player: show one meaningful word from that character's flavor text.
otherNightReminder: The Glyph chooses a player: show one meaningful word from that character's flavor text.

name: Embalmer
ability: Each night, choose a player: if they would come back to life tonight or tomorrow, they don't. [+Tomb]
flavor: They sealed the body in stillness — so it could not rise before the spirit was ready.
firstNightReminder: The Embalmer chooses a player: mark them EMBALMED.
otherNightReminder: The Embalmer chooses a player: mark them EMBALMED.

name: Seer
ability: Each night, you learn if the closest player who woke tonight is clockwise or anti-clockwise of you. If equidistant, this info is arbitrary.
flavor: They watched the shadows move in circles, and read truth in their turning.
firstNightReminder: Point clockwise or anti-clockwise toward the closest player who woke tonight.
otherNightReminder: Point clockwise or anti-clockwise toward the closest player who woke tonight.

name: Sphynx
ability: Each night, choose a player: if they are good, you learn an in-play character; if evil, a not-in-play character.
flavor: Their riddle has no answer — only paths, and each leads to another truth.
firstNightReminder: The Sphynx chooses a player. Show an in-play character if they're good, a not-in-play character if evil.
otherNightReminder: The Sphynx chooses a player. Show an in-play character if they're good, a not-in-play character if evil.

name: Whisper
ability: Each day, you may privately visit the Storyteller and learn a true statement about the evil players.
flavor: They speak only when asked, and only about the hidden — never about the known.

name: Lotus
ability: Once per game, at night, choose 3 players: if exactly one is evil, their ability doesn't work tonight.
flavor: In perfect stillness, it bloomed — a single moment between peace and ruin.
firstNightReminder: The Lotus may choose 3 players. If exactly one is evil, mark them STILL.
otherNightReminder: The Lotus may choose 3 players. If exactly one is evil, mark them STILL.

name: Vessel
ability: Once per game, at night*, choose a player with no ability: they gain a not-in-play Townsfolk ability until dusk tomorrow.
flavor: Empty in form, full in spirit. Those they choose inherit what once was lost.
otherNightReminder: The Vessel may choose a player with no ability. Give them a not-in-play Townsfolk ability: mark FILLED and wake them to show it.

name: Obelisk
ability: Once per game, during the day, guess how many Obelisks sit between you and the closest evil player. If correct, you learn their character. [+0 to +2 Obelisks. 1 of the extras is evil]
flavor: It stands unmoving, but those who speak its number awaken the silence beneath.
otherNightReminder: If the Obelisk guessed correctly today, show the closest evil player's character token.

name: Crook & Flail
ability: The first time you would die, you don't — if a dead player has voted for you.
flavor: Twin emblems of rule — one comforts, the other commands. Yet neither can stop what waits beyond the veil.

name: Wanderer
ability: You think you are a Townsfolk, but you are not. Before night 1, the Demon may swap 2 players' seats.
flavor: They do not know where they began, nor where they walk — only that they walk alone.

name: Outcast
ability: You register as the opposite of your true alignment.
flavor: Cast from both worlds, they reflect only what others wish to see.

name: Mummy
ability: If you are nominated, even if dead, dead players can't vote until dusk tomorrow.
flavor: Cursed in stillness, they bind the voices of the lost with every step toward judgment.

name: Plague
ability: The first time an evil player dies, they still use their ability that night, even if dead.
flavor: Death rides in silence — but even silence can echo, long after the bell has rung.

name: Cultist
ability: On your 1st day, publicly choose 5 players. That night, learn 2 of their characters, then choose 1 of the 5: they turn evil.
flavor: Among the crowd, they smile. But their heart beats to another song.
otherNightReminder: If the Cultist publicly chose 5 players on day 1, show 2 of their character tokens. The Cultist chooses 1 of the 5: they turn evil; wake them to tell them.

name: Flute
ability: Each night, choose a player: if a Minion dies tomorrow, they die too.
flavor: Their presence was a mirror — flawless, until it shattered under weight.
firstNightReminder: The Flute chooses a player: mark them CHARMED.
otherNightReminder: The Flute chooses a player: mark them CHARMED.

name: Mirage
ability: Each night, choose a good character: until tomorrow night, it is treated as in play for every ability, even if it isn't.
flavor: Coiled in waiting, it strikes not the enemy — but the one beside them.
firstNightReminder: The Mirage chooses a good character: place its token as MIRAGE.
otherNightReminder: The Mirage chooses a good character: place its token as MIRAGE.

name: Urn
ability: Each night*, choose a dead player: they regain their ability until dusk, but register falsely and get false information.
flavor: It digs up what was buried, twisting it into a lie that speaks as if true.
otherNightReminder: The Urn chooses a dead player: mark them HAUNTED.

name: Sarcophagus
ability: Each night, choose a dead player: they can't vote tomorrow. The first time you die, you come back to life at dawn.
flavor: Stone keeps its secrets, and its occupants, longer than anyone expects.
firstNightReminder: The Sarcophagus chooses a dead player: mark them SEALED.
otherNightReminder: The Sarcophagus chooses a dead player: mark them SEALED. If the Sarcophagus died today for the first time, they come back to life at dawn.

name: Jackal
ability: Each night*, choose a player: they die. Once per game, choose a dead player instead: they come back to life and turn evil.
flavor: It circles the tombs at night, and what it digs up never stays buried.
otherNightReminder: The Jackal chooses a player: they die. Or, once per game, a dead player: they come back to life and turn evil (wake them to tell them). If the Tomb is in play and players are still dead, the Demon instead chooses a dead player: they come back to life.

name: Ma'at
ability: Each night*, choose a player, they die. If you selected an evil player, choose another player.
flavor: The desert storm has a face, and it wears a smile carved by fire.
otherNightReminder: The Ma'at chooses a player: they die. If that player was evil, the Ma'at chooses another player: they die. If the Tomb is in play and players are still dead, the Demon instead chooses a dead player: they come back to life.

name: Anubis
ability: Each night*, choose 2 players: the first dies; the second registers falsely and gets false information until dusk.
flavor: Judge of bones, guide of shadows — he offers no mercy, only balance.
otherNightReminder: The Anubis chooses 2 players: the first dies; mark the second WEIGHED. If the Tomb is in play and players are still dead, the Demon instead chooses a dead player: they come back to life.

name: Serpent
ability: Each night*, choose a player, they die. If they are an outsider or register as evil, a good neighbor also dies.
flavor: In the silence between breaths, it devours — not flesh, but light.
otherNightReminder: The Serpent chooses a player: they die. If they were an Outsider or registered as evil, a good neighbor also dies. If the Tomb is in play and players are still dead, the Demon instead chooses a dead player: they come back to life.

name: Pyramid
ability: Each night*, choose a player: they die. While the Tomb is resurrecting, you may skip resurrecting: if you do, a living player gets false information tonight. [+Tomb]
flavor: It never sleeps. Behind its walls, memory, fate, and silence become one.
otherNightReminder: The Pyramid chooses a player: they die. While the Tomb is resurrecting, the Pyramid may skip resurrecting; if so, mark a living player FALSE.

name: Tomb
ability: All players start dead (with no abilities). Each night, the Demon brings 1 player back to life instead of killing; each day, the town may vote to bring 1 player back. Once everyone is alive, play continues normally.
flavor: From stillness, it begins. In silence, the players are chosen — not by birth, but by return.
firstNightReminder: If the Tomb is in play, the Demon chooses a dead player: they come back to life. Wake them to tell them.

name: Scorpion
ability: Once per game, during the day, publicly choose a player: if they nominate today, they die.
flavor: It waits in your sandal. It is very patient.
